[[Deldrimor Daggers (unique)|Deldrimor Daggers]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] traded by [[Artisan of Shadows]], a [[collector]] in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1
:Health +30
